items.source_en:
We didn't even have time to scan all the planets here. Our engines are dead.

The Captain... he had enough. We started the Mission with such optimism, but it's been setback after setback.

There are four of us. Dr. Zhao keeps adjusting the experiment program to work without the Galathea.

I told her that we've already lost 20% of the genetic material. I ask who should be prioritized, but I fear she's no longer in her right mind.

I dreamed of having my own command. But not like this.
